items.text: Playoff rematch: the Pistons beat the Magic 4-3 in the 2025-26 playoffs.
The Pistons score 13.4 second-chance points a game (4th fewest); the Magic allow 11.8 (2nd fewest).
Cade Cunningham has 25+ points in 4 straight games against the Magic.
Anthony Black's teams are 7-1 against the Pistons in games he's played in his career.
All-time: the Pistons lead the Magic 73-61 in the regular season; the Magic are 42-26 at home in it (through 11/23/26; both teams' media guides agree)
Largest wins in the series: the Magic by 32 (123-91 on 12/8/23); the Pistons by 40 (1/26/91).
The Celtics have won 11 straight against the Wizards, the longest streak by either team in the series (was 10, the Celtics, 1963-64) (last: 111-100 on 3/14/26).
The Celtics are 17-4 in the last 21 meetings with the Wizards (since 1/8/21).
Anthony Davis has averaged 37.0 points in 2 games against the top 5 defenses and 23.4 in his other 14 (+13.6), the biggest rise in the NBA; the Celtics are 2nd in defensive rating.
Payton Pritchard's teams have won 11 straight against the Wizards with him playing.
The Celtics have won 6 straight road games against the Wizards; the Wizards last beat them at home on 3/28/23.
Trae Young has averaged 28.5 points in 2 games against the top 5 defenses and 15.6 in his other 16 (+12.9), the 2nd-biggest rise in the NBA; the Celtics are 2nd in defensive rating.
Paul George's teams have won 8 straight against the Wizards with him playing.
The Celtics have won 4 straight season series against the Wizards.
Payton Pritchard's teams are 17-3 against the Wizards in games he's played in his career.
Derrick White's teams are 17-1 against the Wizards in games he's played in his career.
Jayson Tatum's teams have won 7 straight against the Wizards with him playing.
Derrick White's teams have won 9 straight against the Wizards with him playing.
Alex Sarr has averaged 17.0 points in 2 games against the top 5 defenses and 10.5 in his other 15 (+6.5), the 8th-biggest rise in the NBA; the Celtics are 2nd in defensive rating.

The Wizards have scored 112.8 points per 100 possessions in 2 games against the top 5 defenses and 107.7 against everyone else (+5.2), the biggest rise in the NBA; the Celtics are 2nd in defensive rating.
All-time: the Celtics lead the Wizards 209-120 in the regular season; the Wizards are 75-86 at home in it (through 11/23/26; the Celtics' media guide, and a count of the games agrees)
Nikola Jokić has a double-double in 8 straight games against the Mavericks.
Jamal Murray has 30+ points in 3 straight games against the Mavericks.
Spencer Jones has averaged 12.0 points in 4 games against the Mavericks in his career, his most against any team (4.5 overall).
All-time: the Mavericks lead the Nuggets 100-97 in the regular season; the Nuggets are 62-38 at home in it (through 11/23/26; both teams' media guides agree)
Largest wins in the series: the Nuggets by 36 (127-91 on 2/9/10); the Mavericks by 34 (132-98 on 4/18/96).
